- Confirm exact product/SKU for three line items (we have 3 variants in the quote)
- Lock ARR amounts to 12-mo recurring numbers (some records show MRR or total contract value)
- Clarify next-step in CRM (we currently have mixed notes: PO pending, Legal review, Awaiting demo)
- Set realistic close probabilities for commit reporting (we suggested 60/30/10 but want Redwood input)

Thanks Natalie — and great descriptor (data surgery).

We can definitely get this into a clean state. Logistics and immediate asks from our side: 

1) Please populate the attached template with the single canonical SKU per line item and indicate whether ARR is: "recurring-12mo" or "one-time" (we'll normalize any MRR to 12x unless you mark otherwise).
2) For any line item that references a demo or feature gating, put the explicit next step using our CRM picklist values: "PO Received", "Legal Review", "Demo Scheduled", "Technical Sign-off". Free-text notes are fine but the picklist value is required for probability mapping.
3) For deals currently in "proposal" stage, give us your internal confidence and then pick an internal probability from this set: 20, 40, 60, 80, 95. We map those to commit buckets in Finance.
4) If a line is contingent on a contract clause (see your excerpt), mark it as "contract-dependent" and add a 5-line summary in the notes column.

I’ve attached a slightly annotated template with examples (row 2 shows how to mark a one-off professional services SKU vs. a 12-mo subscription). Once we receive it, Ben will run a quick pass and return a one-page reconciliation showing the before/after values we’ll publish to the forecast.

Proposed sync: 20–30 min tomorrow (2028-07-11) at 11:00am PT — either quick call or video. Marcus/Natalie, does that work?

Attachments: [Attachment: data_surgery_template_filled_example.csv]

Best,
Lauren Bishop

- For ARR normalizations we will convert any MRR entries to 12x MRR and flag the change in the reconciliation. If NovaApps prefers to show committed ARR as ACV instead, note that explicitly in the "amount_type" column.
- For probability mapping: if NovaApps chooses 60/30/10 as a starting point, Finance recommends adjusting the middle deal (proposal with legal outstanding) down to 40 unless Legal has said timing is not a blocker.
- Please confirm billing cadence for any professional services; if billed up-front we will not treat that as recurring ARR.

Follow-ups I need from NovaApps (action items):
1) Populate the template with SKU codes exactly as they appear on the quote (we match SKU -> product tier).
2) Add a single canonical "close_reason" if known (e.g., PO received, cancelled, price pushback).
3) If you want us to include a deal in the committed forecast, mark the "commit_flag" column yes/no. We only publish rows marked yes.

If you send the filled template by 2028-07-11 23:59 PT we can fold updates into Friday's forecast publish. Otherwise they'll be in next week's window.
